name: ceramics-admin-webapp

dependencies.name: ceramics-api
dependencies.description: Catalog/inventory CRUD and order list/detail/status/refund management operations.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Staff sign-in (OIDC); the caller's admin role is carried in the Thunder groups claim and enforced by ceramics-api.

description: The staff-only back-office SPA. Lets store admins manage the product catalog (create/edit/retire products and variants, adjust stock) and manage orders (view, filter, update fulfillment status, refund/cancel). Exposed only on the org intranet boundary; every action requires an authenticated admin-role sign-in via Thunder.
